title: An injective map of coordinate vector spaces has a linear retraction
statement: Let $K$ be a field [def-weil-field], and let $n,p\ge0$ be integers. Write $K^n$ and $K^p$ for the sets of tuples with coordinatewise addition and scalar multiplication. A map is $K$-linear if it preserves addition and scalar multiplication. For every injective $K$-linear map $f:K^n\to K^p$, there is a $K$-linear map $g:K^p\to K^n$ with $g(f(v))=v$ for every $v\in K^n$.
